reason: The current baseline varies widely (878–1390 GFLOP/s), so the supplied scores do not support attributing effects to any candidate. I rank low-overhead changes to existing work first: merging streaming regions, simplifying proven full-tile store bounds, and changing MOPA scheduling. Next are layout and traversal experiments with plausible reuse or conflict benefits but uncertain locality. Store-through-SVE proposals have limited probe support, but no full GEMM timing, so I rank them below simpler changes. Packing, scratch redesign, and transpose fusion add substantial data movement, allocation, or repeated work; the combined-panel proposal also fills the reported L1D capacity before other data. Paired-load-only was rejected after losses in all three fresh pairs and is not repeated here.
